description: Stockholm Public Transport (SL) static GTFS merged with the observed arrival/departure times reported via GTFS-RT TripUpdates and ServiceAlerts, 2024 Dataset is a data set deposited in ddex.xsafoo by its authors Matej Cebecauer, Daniel Chaves (KTH Royal Institute of Technology). This dataset is not a snapshot or sequence of snapshots of vehicle-trip progress, but rather a daily summary of all arrival and departure observations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
